_note: Kinds of island Marlow's tours can land on (read by TourKinds). After the first trip, rare_chance of tours land on one of the rare kinds, picked by weight. arrive: Marlow's toast on landing. fruit_trees: share of trees that bear fruit, of every kind. flower_clusters: [min, max] patches of mixed flowers, rare_flowers the share in rare colours. rocks: how many rocks, rock_table what they give. critters: more fish and bugs about; creatures with "islands" in data/creatures.json only live on those kinds.

plain.name: Island
plain.arrive: Land ho! Talk to Marlow when you're ready to sail home.

orchard.name: Orchard island
orchard.arrive: Land ho! Fruit trees as far as the eye can see. Every kind!

meadow.name: Flower meadow
meadow.arrive: Land ho! It's all flowers. Some colours Marlow's never seen before!

quarry.name: Rocky island
quarry.arrive: Land ho! Rocks everywhere, and Marlow swears there's gold in them.

buggy.name: Bug island
buggy.arrive: Land ho! Listen to it buzz. Bugs you won't find at home!

fishy.name: Fishing island
fishy.arrive: Land ho! The fish round here are a funny shape. Rare ones, Marlow reckons.
